events.titleEn: Villages flourish along the Coatzacoalcos River
events.summaryEn: Villages along the Coatzacoalcos River drainage on the Gulf of Mexico flourish. They draw on abundant river resources and fertile soils.
events.geographyEn: Coatzacoalcos River drainage, Gulf coast of Mexico
events.selectionNote: The catalog's San Lorenzo record (1500–900 BC) covers the later Olmec centre in the same drainage; its range begins after 1600 BC. This record covers the drainage's villages.

date.noteEn: The Met gives an approximate century and spells the phase "Capo-Grazini".

events.titleEn: Lipari villagers leave the shore for the volcanic heights
events.summaryEn: During the Capo-Grazini phase on the Lipari Islands, people abandon sites near the sea. They move their villages to safer positions on the volcanic slopes or summits.
events.selectionNote: No catalog or English record covers the Lipari Islands. This record covers a shift of settlement away from the coast.
